cluster_name.description: Cluster host-name prefix filter (e.g. 'es-prod' to match es-prod-es-default-0/1). Use an empty string to query all clusters.

lookback.description: Lookback window as ES|QL time span text (e.g. '1 hour', '3 hours', '24 hours').

node_name.description: Optional exact host.name filter to scope to a single node. Use an empty string to query all nodes.

configuration.query:
FROM elastic-cloud-logs-8
| WHERE @timestamp >= NOW() - TO_TIMEDURATION(?lookback)
| WHERE event.dataset == "elasticsearch.server"
| WHERE (?cluster_name == "" OR STARTS_WITH(host.name, ?cluster_name))
| WHERE (?node_name == "" OR host.name == ?node_name)
| WHERE log.level IN ("ERROR", "WARN")
    OR message LIKE "*health status changed*"
    OR message LIKE "*node-left*"
    OR message LIKE "*node-join*"
    OR message LIKE "*allocation*"
    OR message LIKE "*OutOfMemory*"
    OR message LIKE "*circuit_break*"
    OR message LIKE "*recovered*"
| KEEP @timestamp, log.level, host.name, message
| SORT @timestamp DESC
| LIMIT 50

description: Query Elasticsearch server logs for cluster state transitions, node join/leave events, allocation failures, OOM errors, and circuit-breaker events. Use after detecting a yellow/red period to identify the root cause.
